id: # Why a project in infra_se.csv has a blank budget_msek. The blank is deliberate:
# no figure is invented, apportioned or converted anywhere in this pipeline. Two
#   programme      the project is funded inside a larger programme and the source
#                  publishes no cost for it on its own
#   not_published  the source states no cost at all
# A project with a blank budget and no row here defaults to not_published.

state: the note is what the source's own page says.
` is the separator, so a note never contains one.
